Introduction

A planned JSON REST facade for App Store Connect, designed to make common app metadata tasks easier to address.

Parsequerade is a design for a self-hosted service between client tools and Apple's App Store Connect API. The planned facade would handle Apple's authentication, resource relationships, and report decoding, then return predictable JSON and resource URLs to clients.

This repository documents the design. The service is not implemented, and no Parsequerade API is available yet.

Overview

Planned work

The proposal covers app and localization reads, selected metadata updates, sales report decoding, and previewable metadata-copy workflows. The route and field details remain proposed contracts.

The repository's README and implementation plan contain the full proposal and current milestones.
